settings.title: Course Settings
settings.fallbackKeysDesc: When the active key fails, try other keys in order

answerLast5sTable.title: Submission timing: 8 combinations
answerLast5sTable.aiOnLimited: Wait for AI until the last 1–5s window before the deadline; submit a random/blank fallback if AI hasn't returned by then
answerLast5sTable.aiOnUnlimited: Wait indefinitely for AI, then submit on return; fall back to random/blank if the call fails
answerLast5sTable.aiOffLimited: Submit as soon as AI returns; wait up to 1s before the deadline, then submit a random/blank fallback
answerLast5sTable.aiOffUnlimited: Wait indefinitely for AI, then submit on return; fall back to random/blank if the call fails
answerLast5sTable.fallbackOnLimited: Submit in the last 1–5s before the deadline (random choice or blank text)
answerLast5sTable.fallbackOnUnlimited: Submit immediately (random choice or blank text)
answerLast5sTable.fallbackOffLimited: Submit immediately (random choice or blank text)
answerLast5sTable.fallbackOffUnlimited: Submit immediately (random choice or blank text)

settings.pushdeerEndpointHint: Defaults to the official api2.pushdeer.com. Self-hosted users can enter a private endpoint. Get your Key from the PushDeer app.
settings.courseEnabledDesc: When off, this course is ignored entirely (no sign-in, no quiz answering, no danmu, no notifications).
settings.pollIntervalDesc: How often to check Yuketang for active lessons. Allowed: {{min}}–{{max}}s (default {{default}}s). Lower = faster lesson detection but more API requests.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.confirmDelete: Delete this account? All its settings, courses and keys will be erased.

events.ai_failed: AI answering failed, please answer manually! A random (choice) or blank (short-answer) fallback will be submitted per the "Answer in Last 5s" setting

common.betaWarning: AI answer accuracy is not guaranteed. If no key is configured, random answering is used as fallback.
